{"consolidated_memory":"CONSOLIDATED MEMORY: Dropped Frames in realtime/ws/session.ts

Component: realtime/ws/session.ts (realtime side)
Stack: TypeScript
Covering test: realtime/ws/session.test.ts
Core problem: dropped frames in websocket session, surfaced as frames missing from client sequence
Repro pattern: hold socket open through network flap (common to all incidents)

This memory documents SIX SEPARATE OCCASIONS with distinct root causes and fixes, all within the same corner of the codebase:

OCCASION 1 [2026-01-24] - Non-ASCII Names Trigger
- Specific issue: dropped frames only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in single query
- PR #2341 on branch fix/dropped-frames-1
- Result: backlog cleared 4 minutes after deploy

OCCASION 2 [2026-03-12] - Large Payload Threshold
- Specific issue: dropped frames only for payloads above roughly 2 megabytes
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #4440 on branch fix/dropped-frames-2
- Result: reclaimed 61 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 3 [2026-04-10] - Empty Input List Edge Case
- Specific issue: dropped frames only when input list came in empty
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #5423 on branch fix/dropped-frames-3
- Result: flaky test went from 13 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 4 [2026-07-13] - Request Race Condition
- Specific issue: dropped frames when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #6370 on branch fix/dropped-frames-4
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 32 consecutive days

OCCASION 5 [2026-08-03] - Corporate Proxy Traffic
- Specific issue: dropped frames only for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #7707 on branch fix/dropped-frames-5
- Result: error rate dropped from 2.0 percent to under 1 per ten thousand

OCCASION 6 [2026-08-12] - High Cardinality Tenant Keys
- Specific issue: dropped frames only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #8158 on branch fix/dropped-frames-6
- Result: throughput rose 87 percent, to 371 requests per second"}
